After a slip, remember Allah at once and ask His forgiveness.
Do not knowingly persist in a sin.

47:3.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ
47:3.en: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and because those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus Allah coineth their similitudes for mankind

47:4.ar: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضࣲۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:4.en: Now when ye meet in battle those who disbelieve, then it is smiting of the necks until, when ye have routed them, then making fast of bonds; and afterward either grace or ransom till the war lay down its burdens. That (is the ordinance). And if Allah willed He could have punished them (without you) but (thus it is ordained) that He may try some of you by means of others. And those who are slain in the way of Allah, He rendereth not their actions vain

47:5.en: He will guide them and improve their state

47:6.en: And bring them in unto the Garden which He hath made known to them

47:7.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ
47:7.en: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm

47:8.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ وَأَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:8.en: And those who disbelieve, perdition is for them, and He will make their actions vain

47:9.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:9.en: That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless

47:10.ar: ۞أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡثَٰلُهَا
47:10.en: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? Allah wiped them out. And for the disbelievers there will be the like thereof

47:11.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:11.en: That is because Allah is patron of those who believe, and because the disbelievers have no patron

47:12.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأۡكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوࣰ ى لَّهُمۡ
47:12.en: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; while those who disbelieve take their comfort in this life and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire is their habitation

47:13.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةࣰ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَتۡكَ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ
47:13.en: And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper

47:14.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم
47:14.en: Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts

47:15.ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنࣲ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن لَّبَنࣲ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ خَمۡرࣲ لَّذَّةࣲ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ عَسَلࣲ مُّصَفࣰّ ىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدࣱ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمࣰ ا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ
47:15.en: A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels

47:16.ar: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ
47:16.en: Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts

47:17.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ زَادَهُمۡ هُدࣰ ى وَءَاتَىٰهُمۡ تَقۡوَىٰهُمۡ
47:17.en: While as for those who walk aright, He addeth to their guidance, and giveth them their protection (against evil)

47:18.ar: فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ أَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمۡ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرَىٰهُمۡ
47:18.en: Await they aught save the Hour, that it should come upon them unawares? And the beginnings thereof have already come. But how, when it hath come upon them, can they take their warning

47:19.ar: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ
47:19.en: So know (O Muhammad) that there is no Allah save Allah, and ask forgiveness for thy sin and for believing men and believing women. Allah knoweth (both) your place of turmoil and your place of rest

47:20.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُورَةࣱۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةࣱ مُّحۡكَمَةࣱ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلۡقِتَالُ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ ٱلۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَأَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:20.en: And those who believe say: If only a surah were revealed! But when a decisive surah is revealed and war is mentioned therein, thou seest those in whose hearts is a disease looking at thee with the look of men fainting unto death. Therefor woe unto them

47:21.ar: طَاعَةࣱ وَقَوۡلࣱ مَّعۡرُوفࣱۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ
47:21.en: Obedience and a civil word. Then, when the matter is determined, if they are loyal to Allah it will be well for them

47:22.ar: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ
47:22.en: Would ye then, if ye were given the command, work corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship

47:23.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمۡ وَأَعۡمَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ
47:23.en: Such are they whom Allah curseth so that He deafeneth them and maketh blind their eyes

47:24.ar: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ
47:24.en: Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts

47:25.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡ وَأَمۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:25.en: Lo! those who turn back after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, Satan hath seduced them, and He giveth them the rein

47:26.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُواْ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِسۡرَارَهُمۡ
47:26.en: That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk

47:27.ar: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمۡ وَأَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ
47:27.en: Then how (will it be with them) when the angels gather them, smiting their faces and their backs

47:28.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُواْ مَآ أَسۡخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:28.en: That will be because they followed that which angereth Allah, and hated that which pleaseth Him. Therefor He hath made their actions vain

47:29.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ
47:29.en: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease deem that Allah will not bring to light their (secret) hates

47:30.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيۡنَٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡۚ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي لَحۡنِ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:30.en: And if We would, We could show them unto thee (Muhammad) so that thou shouldst know them surely by their marks. And thou shalt know them by the burden of their talk. And Allah knoweth your deeds

47:31.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبۡلُوَاْ أَخۡبَارَكُمۡ
47:31.en: And verily We shall try you till We know those of you who strive hard (for the cause of Allah) and the steadfast, and till We test your record

47:32.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَسَيُحۡبِطُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:32.en: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and oppose the messenger after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, they hurt Allah not a jot, and He will make their actions fruitless

47:33.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:33.en: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and render not your actions vain

47:34.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارࣱ فَلَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ
47:34.en: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and then die disbelievers, Allah surely will not pardon them

47:35.ar: فَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّلۡمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:35.en: So do not falter and cry out for peace when ye (will be) the uppermost, and Allah is with you, and He will not grudge (the reward of) your actions

47:36.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبࣱ وَلَهۡوࣱۚ وَإِن تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ أُجُورَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَكُمۡ
47:36.en: The life of the world is but a sport and a pastime. And if ye believe and ward off (evil). He will give you your wages, and will not ask of you your wordly wealth

47:37.ar: إِن يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُواْ وَيُخۡرِجۡ أَضۡغَٰنَكُمۡ
47:37.en: If He should ask it of you and importune you, ye would hoard it, and He would bring to light your (secret) hates

47:38.ar: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبۡخَلُۖ وَمَن يَبۡخَلۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ أَمۡثَٰلَكُم
47:38.en: Lo! ye are those who are called to spend in the way of Allah, yet among you there are some who hoard. And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul. And Allah is the Rich, and ye are the poor. And if ye turn away He will exchange you for some other folk, and they will not be the likes of you

48:1.ar: إِنَّا فَتَحۡنَا لَكَ فَتۡحࣰ ا مُّبِينࣰ ا
48:1.en: Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory

48:2.ar: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا مُّسۡتَقِيمࣰ ا
48:2.en: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path

48:3.en: And that Allah may help thee with strong help

48:4.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
48:4.en: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise

48:5.ar: لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمࣰ ا
48:5.en: That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph

48:6.ar: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَنَهُمۡ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرࣰ ا
48:6.en: And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end

48:7.ar: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
48:7.en: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise

48:8.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدࣰ ا وَمُبَشِّرࣰ ا وَنَذِيرࣰ ا
48:8.en: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner

48:9.ar: لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلًا
48:9.en: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day

48:10.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمࣰ ا
48:10.en: Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward

48:11.ar: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡنَآ أَمۡوَٰلُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَاۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلۡسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيۡسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ فَمَن يَمۡلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ ضَرًّا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ نَفۡعَۢاۚ بَلۡ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرَۢا
48:11.en: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do

48:12.ar: بَلۡ ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِيهِمۡ أَبَدࣰ ا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمَۢا بُورࣰ ا
48:12.en: Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk

48:13.ar: وَمَن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرࣰ ا
48:13.en: And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers

48:14.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣰ ا رَّحِيمࣰ ا
48:14.en: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

48:15.ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقۡتُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأۡخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعۡكُمۡۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبۡلُۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلۡ تَحۡسُدُونَنَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ ا
48:15.en: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little

48:16.ar: قُل لِّلۡمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ سَتُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ أُوْلِي بَأۡسࣲ شَدِيدࣲ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمۡ أَوۡ يُسۡلِمُونَۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجۡرًا حَسَنࣰ اۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
48:16.en: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom

48:17.ar: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجࣱۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
48:17.en: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom

48:18.ar: ۞لَّقَدۡ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَٰبَهُمۡ فَتۡحࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا
48:18.en: Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory

48:19.ar: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةࣰ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
48:19.en: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise

48:20.ar: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمۡ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيۡدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمۡ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَيَهۡدِيَكُمۡ صِرَٰطࣰ ا مُّسۡتَقِيمࣰ ا
48:20.en: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path

48:21.ar: وَأُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ تَقۡدِرُواْ عَلَيۡهَا قَدۡ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣰ ا
48:21.en: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things

48:22.ar: وَلَوۡ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيࣰّ ا وَلَا نَصِيرࣰ ا
48:22.en: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper

48:23.ar: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلࣰ ا
48:23.en: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change

48:24.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَنكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡهُم بِبَطۡنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
48:24.en: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do

48:25.ar: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالࣱ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءࣱ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتࣱ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمࣲۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
48:25.en: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment

48:26.ar: إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣰ ا
48:26.en: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things

48:27.ar: لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحࣰ ا قَرِيبًا
48:27.en: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand

48:28.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدࣰ ا
48:28.en: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness

48:29.ar: مُّحَمَّدࣱ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعࣰ ا سُجَّدࣰ ا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنࣰ اۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣰ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا
48:29.en: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward

49:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
49:1.en: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower

49:2.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
49:2.en: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not

49:3.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣱ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ
49:3.en: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward

49:4.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
49:4.en: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense

49:5.ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرࣰ ا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
49:5.en: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

49:6.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإࣲ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةࣲ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ
49:6.en: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did

49:7.ar: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
49:7.en: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided

49:8.ar: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةࣰۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
49:8.en: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise

49:9.ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
49:9.en: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable

49:10.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةࣱ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
49:10.en: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy

49:11.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمࣱ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءࣱ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
49:11.en: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers

49:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمࣱۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتࣰ ا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
49:12.en: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful

49:13.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرࣲ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبࣰ ا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرࣱ‏
49:13.en: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware

49:14.ar: ۞قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
49:14.en: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

49:15.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
49:15.en: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere

49:16.ar: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏
49:16.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things

49:17.ar: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
49:17.en: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest

49:18.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
49:18.en: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do

50:2.ar: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
50:2.en: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing

50:3.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ اۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدࣱ‏
50:3.en: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return

50:4.ar: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
50:4.en: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book

50:5.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرࣲ مَّرِيجٍ
50:5.en: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case

50:6.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
50:6.en: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein

50:7.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجࣲ‏
50:7.en: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon

50:8.en: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave

50:9.ar: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
50:9.en: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops

50:10.en: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters

50:11.ar: رِّزۡقࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
50:11.en: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead

50:12.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
50:12.en: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud

50:13.en: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

50:14.ar: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲۚ كُلࣱّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
50:14.en: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect

50:15.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏
50:15.en: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation

50:16.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
50:16.en: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

50:17.ar: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدࣱ‏
50:17.en: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left

50:18.ar: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدࣱ‏
50:18.en: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready

50:19.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
50:19.en: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun

50:20.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
50:20.en: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day

50:21.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقࣱ وَشَهِيدࣱ‏
50:21.en: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness

50:22.ar: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
50:22.en: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

50:23.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
50:23.en: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony)

50:24.ar: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدࣲ‏
50:24.en: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate

50:26.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
50:26.en: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom

50:27.ar: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
50:27.en: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error

50:28.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
50:28.en: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning

50:29.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
50:29.en: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves

50:30.ar: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏
50:30.en: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come

50:31.en: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant

50:32.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظࣲ‏
50:32.en: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one

50:33.ar: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبࣲ مُّنِيبٍ
50:33.en: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart

50:34.en: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality

50:35.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدࣱ‏
50:35.en: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us

50:36.ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
50:36.en: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)

50:37.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدࣱ‏
50:37.en: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence

50:38.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
50:38.en: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us

50:39.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
50:39.en: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun

50:40.en: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations

50:41.ar: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏
50:41.en: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place

50:42.ar: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
50:42.en: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)

50:43.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
50:43.en: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying

50:44.ar: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏
50:44.en: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make)

50:45.ar: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارࣲۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
50:45.en: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat

51:1.en: By those that winnow with a winnowing

51:2.en: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

51:3.en: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

51:4.en: And those who distribute (blessings) by command

51:5.en: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true

51:6.en: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall

51:7.en: By the heaven full of paths

51:8.en: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth)

51:9.en: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse

51:11.en: Who are careless in an abyss

51:12.en: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment

51:13.en: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire

51:14.ar: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
51:14.en: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten

51:15.en: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings

51:16.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
51:16.en: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good

51:17.ar: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
51:17.en: They used to sleep but little of the night

51:18.en: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness

51:19.en: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share

51:20.en: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure

51:21.en: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see

51:22.en: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised

51:23.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
51:23.en: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak

51:24.ar: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
51:24.en: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)

51:25.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
51:25.en: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me)

51:26.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلࣲ سَمِينࣲ‏
51:26.en: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf

51:27.en: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat

51:28.ar: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
51:28.en: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son

51:29.ar: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏
51:29.en: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman

51:30.ar: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
51:30.en: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower

51:31.en: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)

51:32.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
51:32.en: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk

51:33.en: That we may send upon them stones of clay

51:34.en: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton

51:35.ar: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
51:35.en: Then we brought forth such believers as were there

51:36.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
51:36.en: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah)

51:37.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
51:37.en: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom

51:38.ar: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
51:38.en: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant

51:39.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونࣱ‏
51:39.en: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman

51:40.ar: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
51:40.en: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate

51:41.ar: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
51:41.en: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them

51:42.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
51:42.en: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust

51:43.ar: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
51:43.en: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile

51:44.ar: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
51:44.en: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed

51:45.ar: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامࣲ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
51:45.en: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves

51:46.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
51:46.en: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk

51:47.en: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof)

51:48.en: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)

51:49.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
51:49.en: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect

51:50.ar: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
51:50.en: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him

51:51.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
51:51.en: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him

51:52.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
51:52.en: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman

51:53.ar: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
51:53.en: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk

51:54.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy

51:55.en: And warn, for warning profiteth believers

51:56.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
51:56.en: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me

51:57.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقࣲ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
51:57.en: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me

51:58.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
51:58.en: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might

51:59.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبࣰ ا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
51:59.en: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day)

51:60.ar: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
51:60.en: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised

52:7.en: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass

52:8.en: There is none that can ward it off

52:9.en: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving

52:10.en: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement

52:11.en: Then woe that day unto the deniers

52:12.en: Who play in talk of grave matters

52:13.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
52:13.en: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

52:14.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
52:14.en: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny

52:15.ar: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
52:15.en: Is this magic, or do ye not see

52:16.ar: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
52:16.en: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

52:17.en: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight

52:18.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
52:18.en: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire

52:19.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
52:19.en: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do

52:20.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
52:20.en: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

52:21.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
52:21.en: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned

52:22.en: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire

52:23.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
52:23.en: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin

52:24.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
52:24.en: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls

52:25.en: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning

52:26.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
52:26.en: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious

52:27.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
52:27.en: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire

52:28.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
52:28.en: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful

52:29.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
52:29.en: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman

52:30.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
52:30.en: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time

52:31.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
52:31.en: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant

52:32.ar: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
52:32.en: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk

52:33.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
52:33.en: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe

52:34.ar: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
52:34.en: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful

52:35.ar: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
52:35.en: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators

52:36.ar: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
52:36.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing

52:37.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
52:37.en: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)

52:38.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
52:38.en: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest

52:39.en: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons

52:40.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
52:40.en: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt

52:41.en: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down

52:42.ar: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
52:42.en: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared

52:43.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
52:43.en: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

52:44.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
52:44.en: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds

52:45.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
52:45.en: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken

52:46.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
52:46.en: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped

52:47.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
52:47.en: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not

52:48.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
52:48.en: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest

52:49.en: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars

53:1.en: By the Star when it setteth

53:2.en: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived

53:3.en: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire

53:4.en: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired

53:5.en: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him

53:6.en: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

53:7.en: When he was on the uppermost horizon

53:8.en: Then he drew nigh and came down

53:9.en: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer

53:10.en: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed

53:11.en: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw

53:12.en: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth

53:13.en: And verily he saw him yet another time

53:14.en: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary

53:15.en: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode

53:16.en: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree

53:17.en: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold

53:18.ar: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
53:18.en: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord

53:19.en: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza

53:20.en: And Manat, the third, the other

53:21.en: Are yours the males and His the females

53:22.en: That indeed were an unfair division

53:23.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
53:23.en: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them

53:24.en: Or shall man have what he coveteth

53:25.en: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former

53:26.ar: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
53:26.en: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth

53:27.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
53:27.en: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females

53:28.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
53:28.en: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth

53:29.ar: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
53:29.en: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world

53:30.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
53:30.en: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right

53:31.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
53:31.en: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness

53:32.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
53:32.en: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil)

53:33.en: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away

53:34.en: And gave a little, then was grudging

53:35.en: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth

53:36.ar: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
53:36.en: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

53:37.en: And Abraham who paid his debt

53:38.en: That no laden one shall bear another's load

53:39.ar: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
53:39.en: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort

53:40.en: And that his effort will be seen

53:41.en: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment

53:42.en: And that thy Lord, He is the goal

53:43.en: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep

53:44.en: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life

53:45.en: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female

53:46.en: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth

53:47.en: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth

53:48.en: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth

53:49.en: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius

53:50.en: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad

53:51.en: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not

53:52.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
53:52.en: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious

53:54.en: So that there covered them that which did cover

53:55.en: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute

53:56.en: This is a warner of the warners of old

53:58.ar: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
53:58.en: None beside Allah can disclose it

53:59.en: Marvel ye then at this statement

54:1.en: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain

54:2.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
54:2.en: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion

54:3.ar: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
54:3.en: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

53:62.en: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him

112:1.en: Say: He is Allah, the One

112:2.en: Allah, the eternally Besought of all

112:3.en: He begetteth not nor was begotten

112:4.en: And there is none comparable unto Him

qp_tB-FGydo.title: Ramadan 2023, Night 25: Tarawih Recitation (Muhammad to Al-Najm)
qp_tB-FGydo.one_line: Night 25 tarawih and witr: recitation from Surat Muhammad through al-Najm and the opening of al-Qamar, closing with a long qunut supplication.
qp_tB-FGydo.summary: The night's tarawih prayer in Arabic, with no talk. The recitation runs from early in Surat Muhammad, on fighting those who block Allah's path, the rivers of Paradise and the hypocrites who will not reflect on the Quran, through al-Fath with the pledge under the tree, Hudaybiyyah and the description of the Prophet's companions, al-Hujurat with its manners toward the Prophet, verification of news, reconciliation, brotherhood and the ban on mockery, suspicion and backbiting, then Qaf, al-Dhariyat and al-Tur on resurrection, judgment and the fate of earlier nations, and al-Najm with the Prophet's vision and the closing prostration, plus the first verses of al-Qamar. Witr ends with a qunut supplication asking for guidance, forgiveness, freedom from the Fire for the worshippers and their families, acceptance of the month's fasting and prayer, relief for the distressed and oppressed, protection of Muslim blood, support for those holding on at al-Aqsa, and the Prophet's company in Paradise.

outline.heading: Muhammad: fighting, Allah's help and the fate of deniers
outline.gist: Recited in prayer: help Allah and He will help you; the deeds of those who hate revelation are void.

outline.heading: Muhammad: the rivers of Paradise and heedless listeners
outline.gist: Rivers of water, milk, wine and honey, those who leave the Prophet's gathering understanding nothing, and the command to know there is no god but Allah.

outline.heading: Interlude
Muhammad: the hypocrites and reflecting on the Quran
outline.gist: The sick-hearted dread the call to fight; do they not reflect on the Quran, or are there locks on their hearts?

outline.heading: Close of Muhammad and the opening of al-Fath
outline.gist: Do not weaken and call for peace; Allah needs nothing from you; then the clear victory and tranquillity sent into believers' hearts.

outline.heading: Interlude
Al-Fath: the pledge and those who stayed behind
outline.gist: Allah's hand is over the hands of those who pledge; the Bedouins who stayed behind make excuses; Allah is pleased with those who pledged under the tree.

outline.heading: Al-Fath: Hudaybiyyah and the description of the companions
outline.gist: Promised gains, the restraint at Makkah, the true dream of entering the Sacred Mosque, and the companions firm against disbelievers and merciful among themselves.

outline.heading: Interlude
Al-Hujurat: manners with the Prophet and verifying news
outline.gist: Do not put yourselves before Allah and His Messenger or raise your voices; verify news brought by a sinner.

outline.heading: Al-Hujurat: brotherhood, suspicion, backbiting and equality
outline.gist: Reconcile fighting believers; no mockery, nicknames, suspicion, spying or backbiting; the most honoured is the most God-conscious; faith versus mere submission.

outline.heading: Interlude
Qaf: denying resurrection and the signs of creation
outline.gist: They marvel at being raised from dust, while the sky, the earth, rain and revived land show how the resurrection will come.

outline.heading: Qaf: the recording angels, death and judgment
outline.gist: Allah is closer than the jugular vein, every word is recorded, death's stupor comes, Hell asks for more, Paradise is brought near, and the Quran reminds those who fear the warning.

outline.heading: Interlude
Al-Dhariyat: the promise, the God-conscious and destroyed nations
outline.gist: The promise is true; the God-conscious slept little and sought forgiveness before dawn; Ibrahim's guests, Lut's town, Pharaoh, Ad, Thamud and Nuh's people; so flee to Allah.

outline.heading: Close of al-Dhariyat and al-Tur
outline.gist: Jinn and humans were created to worship; then the oath by the Mount, the certain punishment, and the joys of the God-conscious with their offspring joined to them.

outline.heading: Interlude
Al-Tur's challenge and al-Najm: the Prophet's vision
outline.gist: Were they created from nothing? Then the Prophet does not speak from desire, his vision at the farthest lote tree, and the empty names of al-Lat, al-Uzza and Manat.

outline.heading: Al-Najm: each soul bears its own deeds; the prostration
outline.gist: Do not claim purity for yourselves; no one bears another's burden and each gets only what he strove for; the surah ends in prostration, followed by the moon splitting.

outline.heading: Witr: al-Ikhlas
outline.gist: The final rak'ah of witr opens with al-Ikhlas.

outline.heading: Qunut supplication
outline.gist: Praise, asking for guidance and well-being, repentance, freedom from the Fire for worshippers and their families, acceptance of Ramadan, relief for the oppressed, and support for those at al-Aqsa.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.note: Tarawih recitation covering Muhammad through al-Najm.

themes.label: Dua and invocation
themes.note: A long qunut asking for forgiveness, freedom from the Fire and acceptance of the month.

60:7.ar: ۞عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيۡتُم مِّنۡهُم مَّوَدَّةࣰۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرࣱۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
60:7.en: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

60:8.ar: لَّا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمۡ يُخۡرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمۡ وَتُقۡسِطُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
60:8.en: Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers

60:9.ar: إِنَّمَا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَٰتَلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخۡرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ وَظَٰهَرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡرَاجِكُمۡ أَن تَوَلَّوۡهُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
60:9.en: Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong-doers

62:2.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي ٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ لَفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
62:2.en: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest

64:14.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوࣰّ ا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
64:14.en: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

68:3.en: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing

68:4.en: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature

68:51.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
68:51.en: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad

jrzwnBD0sf8.speaker: adnan
jrzwnBD0sf8.speaker_note: leads the nightly reflections, describes being permitted to give khutbahs in his sheikh's masjid and growing up where the 27th night was celebrated
jrzwnBD0sf8.title: Ramadan 2023, Night 27: Quranic Reflections (Al-Mumtahanah to Al-Ma'arij)
jrzwnBD0sf8.one_line: Love between enemies and kindness to peaceful non-Muslims, Jumuah as a leadership system, pardoning spouses and children on the 27th night, and the Prophet's consistent character.
jrzwnBD0sf8.summary: He introduces the surahs on relationships within the ummah and then the requirements of dawah. Al-Mumtahanah hopes Allah will put love between believers and their enemies, and allows the best conduct, beyond mere fairness, toward non-Muslims who have not fought or expelled Muslims, forbidding alliance only with oppressors; nothing here justifies embarrassment or violence. Al-Jumu'ah shows a leadership system built into Islam, yet Muslims who gather weekly by the millions stay disorganized. Whoever takes the minbar stands in the Prophet's place, so a city should have few Jumuahs and khatibs must do the four duties of prophets: make Allah known, purify people, teach the Book, and teach the wisdom to apply it. On the 27th night he takes al-Taghabun 64:14: even when spouses or children act as enemies to your faith, Allah asks you to beware, then pardon, overlook and forgive. Most family grievances are petty, so he asks everyone to pardon their families completely tonight before seeking Allah's pardon. Al-Qalam praises the Prophet's great character, unchanged in every circumstance; Quraysh hunted for a single slip and found none. He ends on what a person gains by accepting Islam.

outline.heading: Opening
Relationships within the ummah
outline.gist: From al-Mumtahanah to al-Tahrim the surahs deal with relationships inside the Muslim community: leadership, domestic life and more.

outline.heading: Tabarak: what a caller to Allah needs
outline.gist: The next cluster gives the requirements of dawah, with examples that worked or failed and the methods it takes.

outline.heading: Interlude
Perhaps Allah will put love between you and your enemies
outline.gist: The word used signals what Allah intends and works toward: love between believers and those who fought them.

outline.heading: How could such a book be called violent?
outline.gist: Allah is capable and forgiving despite past atrocities; a scripture hoping for love between enemies cannot fairly be painted as violent.

outline.heading: Those who have not fought you
outline.gist: Allah does not forbid good relations with non-Muslims who did not fight you, expel you or take your right to believe.

outline.heading: Birr: fairness plus more
outline.gist: Birr is your best conduct, mercy on top of justice, while qist is fairness alone.

outline.heading: No alliance with oppressors
outline.gist: Allah forbids alliances only with those who fight you over faith, expel you or back those who do.

outline.heading: Nothing to hide, nothing violent
outline.gist: These teachings leave no reason to be embarrassed of the faith; the hope of love between enemies has no equal in other scripture.

outline.heading: Al-Jumu'ah and leadership
outline.gist: The Friday prayer is a manifestation of a leadership system that Allah built into the deen.

outline.heading: Wherever three Muslims are, a masjid and a Jumuah
outline.gist: From Iceland to a remote island, Muslims build a masjid and hold Jumuah; organization is instilled by Allah.

outline.heading: Millions gather weekly yet stay disorganized
outline.gist: An ummah that meets every week should have leadership; we are professionals at ruining something that works.

outline.heading: The minbar is the Prophet's place
outline.gist: Whoever stands there stands in for him; he was permitted only after years of study and khutbahs observed by his teachers.

outline.heading: Speak as he would, and keep Jumuahs few
outline.gist: A khatib must say what the Prophet would approve; a city should have only as many Jumuahs as needed, and a hundred shows a scattered society.

outline.heading: First duty: tell people who Allah is
outline.gist: Reciting His signs means explaining who Allah is, what He wants and why we are here, which we cannot know without a prophet.

outline.heading: Second duty: purification
outline.gist: Teach people the monster inside them; without self-awareness and self-accountability there is no hope for anyone.

outline.heading: Third duty: teaching the Book's laws
outline.gist: Teach the laws and rulings of the Book.

outline.heading: Fourth duty: the wisdom to practise them
outline.gist: Teach the wisdom to apply those laws appropriately.

outline.heading: Everything else is an accessory
outline.gist: Those who speak in the Prophet's place should keep to these four and not scatter.

outline.heading: The 27th night, but not the only night
outline.gist: He grew up where the 27th was heavily celebrated and honours it, while holding that it is not the only night to seek.

outline.heading: Interlude
Enemies among your spouses and children
outline.gist: On a night for seeking pardon, he takes a verse no one wants to hear: some of those closest to you may be your enemies.

outline.heading: What enemy means here
outline.gist: Not domestic violence, which the community must address, but family who hold you back from getting closer to Allah.

outline.heading: Beware, not divorce or disown
outline.gist: Allah gives no ultimatum, only caution: do not let them stop your momentum or good intentions.

outline.heading: Then pardon, overlook and forgive
outline.gist: If you pardon and forgive them, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

outline.heading: Even when they block your worship
outline.gist: Even if they try to stop your prayer, fasting and Quran, do not carry a grudge against them.

outline.heading: Most family fights are petty
outline.gist: Usually they love Allah as you do and you clash over trivial worldly things, big egos, small hearts and old baggage.

outline.heading: What will we say to Allah?
outline.gist: If we must forgive actual enemies, what excuse is there for grudges over how someone smiles or comes home?

outline.heading: Pardon your family tonight
outline.gist: Before seeking Allah's pardon tonight, pardon your spouses and children, even those who act as enemies.

outline.heading: Show Allah you can pardon first
outline.gist: If we expect His pardon, we should first show it ourselves.

outline.heading: Start with the closest
outline.gist: Forgiving those who oppressed you is good, but begin with those who matter most and leave nothing in your heart.

outline.heading: The literal meaning of the verse
outline.gist: This is no stretched interpretation but the plain translation; may Allah help us pardon so He pardons us.

outline.heading: You are of great character
outline.gist: An unending reward, and a character described as continuous, like a ball that keeps rolling.

outline.heading: The same man in every moment
outline.gist: Persecuted or victorious, grieving or celebrating, he was equally compassionate, firm, grateful and merciful.

outline.heading: Beaten by his ethics
outline.gist: Smiling after losing loved ones, giving from an empty home, caring for those who tried to kill him: he admits he cannot understand it.

outline.heading: Grand, not just great
outline.gist: Allah calls his character grand because he was different from everyone.

outline.heading: They wanted him to slip
outline.gist: Quraysh stared at him hoping for one lie or wrong, searched for dirt and found nothing.

outline.heading: One slip and Islam would be gone
outline.gist: Finding no flaw they called him insane; had he slipped once, there would be no masjid and no Muslims.

outline.heading: Impeccable and left with nothing
outline.gist: He never cashed in and died with nothing; he is the ultimate model and our efforts are weak attempts to follow him.

outline.heading: Interlude
Accepting Islam: you lose nothing
outline.gist: A new Muslim keeps every prophet he believed in, gains Muhammad, a majestic understanding of Allah and a guiding Book, and joins those who carry tawhid to the human family.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Tolerance, pluralism and dealing with difference
themes.note: Allah hopes for love between enemies and allows our best conduct toward peaceful non-Muslims, forbidding only alliance with oppressors.

themes.label: Significance and etiquettes of Jumuah
themes.note: Jumuah is a built-in leadership system; the minbar is the Prophet's place, and a city should not scatter into many Jumuahs.

themes.label: Public speaking and khutbah delivery
themes.note: A khatib speaks on the Prophet's behalf and must convey who Allah is, purification, the laws and the wisdom to apply them.

themes.label: Tazkiyah: purifying and training the self
themes.note: Purification, facing the monster inside, is one of the four purposes of prophethood.

themes.label: Ramadan: preparation, fasting, making the most of it
themes.note: He honours the 27th night while holding that Laylat al-Qadr should be sought on other nights too.

themes.label: Mercy, forgiveness and pardoning people
themes.note: Pardon spouses and children completely, even when they act as enemies to your faith, before asking Allah's pardon.

themes.label: Family: parents, relatives, kinship ties
themes.note: Most conflict at home is petty and ego-driven; even real obstruction calls for caution and then forgiveness.

themes.label: The Prophet's attributes, character and example
themes.note: His character never changed with circumstances; enemies found no ethical flaw, and he left this world with nothing.

themes.label: Dawah, outreach and representing Islam
themes.note: Accepting Islam loses nothing of earlier faith and gains Muhammad, a majestic understanding of Allah and the Quran.
